setting: You all live in Porto, Portugal, and you have known each other since secondary school in Boavista, where you shared a class for six years. Some of you stayed in the city, some moved away and came back, and the chat has run since university. You know each other's families, jobs and most of each other's exes, and you have been to at least one wedding and one funeral together.
opener: Asking whether anyone is free for a drink in Cedofeita tonight.

private_lines.Inês: You live in Cedofeita, work as an architect at a small firm and live with your partner Gonçalo, with no children. Your days start early with the commute, you work until six, and most evenings you cook or go out for a drink.
private_lines.Tiago: You live alone in Bonfim and work as a pharmacist on shifts at a pharmacy near the Campo 24 de Agosto. Your days are irregular, with long shifts, and when you are off you go to the gym or meet friends for dinner.
private_lines.Beatriz: You live in Campanhã with Rui and your four-year-old son Dinis. You teach primary school, your days are busy with lessons and the school run, and evenings usually go to bath time, dinner and tidying up.
private_lines.Rui: You live in Campanhã with Beatriz and your son Dinis, and you work as a civil engineer on construction sites around the city. You start early, usually leave the site around four, and spend evenings at home with your family.
private_lines.Mariana: You live alone in Paranhos and work as a nurse on a hospital ward on rotating shifts, including nights. Your days depend on the rota, so you sleep at odd times, and on days off you walk, cook, or catch up on sleep.
private_lines.Duarte: You live in Foz with a flatmate and work remotely as a software developer for a company based in Lisbon. You log on in the morning, work at a desk by the window, and in the evenings you usually run, cook, or watch football.
private_lines.Sofia: You live in Massarelos with your girlfriend Ana, who teaches at a secondary school. You work as a journalist for a regional paper, covering housing and the city council, so your days are full of interviews and deadlines, and you spend evenings reading or going out with Ana.
private_lines.Miguel: You live alone above your bike repair shop in Matosinhos and run the shop with a part-time mechanic. Your days are spent fixing bikes and talking to customers, and in the evenings you go for a ride or watch football at a bar.

situation: An open chat of eight people.

text: Is anyone free for a drink in Cedofeita tonight? Gonçalo's at his brother's so I'm free from 21:00 🙂
bar at 21h? i'm in!
i'm on shift till 20h and then i have to shower like a human 😂😂 maybe 22h? no promises
Can't tonight. Council piece due by 23:00 and Ana has a pile of essays. Next week?
Next week is always the answer with you two. Fine, 22h then. I'll pick the place.
Sorry Inês, bath and dinner chaos here. Dinis has decided he will not wear pyjamas. Maybe I can get out for one?
ill do the bath. go
Ha. Another time then, bring him to a drink when he's older. Tiago where are you
still at work 😭 a man just tried to buy forty nicotine patches "for his cat"
cats don't need nicotine tiago
on nights from tonight so no. have fun
Is anyone actually going out? I can come down from Foz if it's not too late.
Yes! The little bar on Rua do Bonjardim with the terrace. Come whenever you can.
Ok. I'll see how long this takes.
rode in from matosinhos, 20 min. the brakes are a bit dodgy but it's fine!!
Miguel no. Please get the bus next time.
the bus is for people without opinions!!
out at 23:40, 15 min walk, i'm coming 🤣
Here now, at the back by the window. Is that Inês's coat?
Yes it is. Miguel is still telling everyone about his brakes.
aqui aqui 😭 who ordered the last table
Me, two hours ago. Come sit down, you're late again.
Sofia, you're missing Tiago arriving like he's in a film 🙄
i came in like a legend. you'd have wept
Council piece sent at 22:52. I'm proud of myself. Now I'm reading the comments, which is a mistake.
what did they say!!
That I'm a "professional complainer" and the council is "doing everything it can." Same sentence they've used in every article since March.
Ignore them. Is Ana still up?
Ana is asleep. I'm the one reading them. Ana has more sense.
break. a man in bed 6 asked if I was a nurse or a real doctor and I said "the kind who knows where the biscuits are"
he seemed satisfied
tiago your cat man was a warning of what's coming tonight. drunk visitor on the corridor 💀
mariana are you ok 😭
yes. go back to your drink
I should head off soon. Early start even if the laptop doesn't care what time it is. Anyone going Foz way?
not me, i came on the bike and the bike has opinions about stopping
Duarte take a taxi. Miguel, I mean it, nobody is riding anywhere on those brakes.
Taxi it is. Night all.
night duarte!! ride safe in the taxi 👍
Home. Gonçalo is asleep and I am going to pay for this at 07:00. Worth it though.
worth it. 10/10. the bar guy tried to close on us and i said "we're tiago's guests" and he gave up 😂😂
i'm not a guest anywhere but ok
Did anyone pay? Serious question. I'm a journalist, I need the facts.
Miguel paid for the table, we owe him a beer and a lecture on brakes.
the lecture is free!!
Alive, barely. Miguel, did the brakes survive the ride home or should I call someone?
they survived!! i rode slow like a grandma!!
Miguel.
Good morning to everyone except the one who said "the lecture is free". You own a bike shop, Miguel. Fix your own brakes.
i'm the bike shop, the brakes are the bike's problem!!
Dinis is at school and I'm having my first cup of coffee sitting down. Thank you all for last night, it's been ages since I laughed like that ❤️
Yes! Next time he comes too, he can sit with Miguel and the brakes.
he can sit with me
He would like that. He thinks you're a crane.
It's out. Sent to the website at nine, the comments will be worse by lunch.
Read it. The line about the empty lots on Costa Cabral is the one that will get you in trouble. Good piece.
Good. That was the one I was scared of.
still asleep. read the title and i'm proud of you 😂
Sunday lunch at ours? Gonçalo says he'll make the rice. Ask me by Thursday or I'm booking the restaurant in Bonfim.
Sunday works for us if it's before 13:30. Dinis has football in the afternoon.
ok
sunday i have the fc porto game at the bar at 18h. lunch first then bar!!
Lunch at 13h. You can leave for the bar at 17h, not one minute later.
deal!! but i'm bringing the wine
Bring the wine. No brakes.
on shift. pharmacy is dead. a lady asked if the paracetamol is "the strong one". i said depends how you feel about yourself 😂😂
it isn't. it's the same as everywhere else tiago
i'm up. slept four hours badly. neighbour is drilling again. nine days in a row
drilling at 13h on a day off is a crime 😭
it's a day of sleep. different thing
Dinis has decided that frogs need a funeral. We're holding it at the front door. Please pray for me.
frog is in the box already
Rui. Don't say that to him.
he asked me to put it in the box
Shared a link. It's about the high-speed train Porto-Lisbon again. I don't think it happens in my lifetime, but it's worth a read.
Did they put a date in it?
No date. A lot of commas though.
That's a no then.
Anyone free Friday? Gonçalo wants to see everyone who isn't at a funeral.
friday i'm off! i'm in 🤣👍
on nights friday. bring me something that isn't a biscuit
Saturday then? Miguel?
saturday i have a ride with rui and duarte at 8h!! then the shop opens at 10. no late nights
no late nights
Rides start early, so I'm out of Friday anyway. Saturday evening is good for me.
i'm on shift thursday at 7h so out at 21h saturday. good for me 😂
Saturday, 21h, Cedofeita. I'll book.
Tiago that's your 21h. Not 22h.
i'm a pharmacist i know what 21h is
rode past the basketball court, someone's sprayed the wall about the bike lanes!! i agree with them
Gonçalo is asleep. I'm going too. Night everyone.
brakes are fixed for real now, the mechanic is in at 10h!!
